```{r gof function}

# using this resource: https://www.montana.edu/screel/teaching/bioe-440r-521/bioe-440-distance-sampling.html

# Goodness of fit test: good fit if results of these tests show p > 0.05. First, fit a model: use your best-supported model (Lowest AIC). Then check GOF for that model.

# Function returning three fit-statistics.

fitstats <- function(fm) {

  observed <- getY(fm@data)

  expected <- fitted(fm)

  resids <- residuals(fm)

  sse <- sum(resids^2)

  chisq <- sum((observed - expected)^2 / expected)

  freeTuke <- sum((sqrt(observed) - sqrt(expected))^2)

  out <- c(SSE=sse, Chisq=chisq, freemanTukey=freeTuke)

  return(out)

}

```


# Read in and prep data

## Read in

```{r data read in}
all_surv_records <- read.csv("Data/all_survey_records_aug2026.csv")
# a record of every segment surveyed, afternoon and night, with length and time

amph_lz <- read.csv("Data/amph_lz_cleaned_aug2026.csv")
# cleaned amphibian and lizard data - a record of every individual found, when, and what segment
# make sure there are no duplicates...
amph_lz <- amph_lz %>%
  distinct(Animal_ID, .keep_all = TRUE) # evidently there was 1

# I cleaned frogs and added a tadpole phase column, now they are a sep df
frogs_df <- read.csv("frogs.csv")
frogs_df$Start_Date <- mdy(frogs_df$Start_Date)

effort <- read.csv("Data/effort_aug2026.csv")
# Date, effort hours, segment length

env_2025 <- read.csv("Data/env_2025_cleaned.csv", encoding = "latin1")
# 2025 env data

env_24_25_nights <- read.csv("Data/env_24_25_nights_aug2026.csv")
# night time survey environmental data both years

small.mamms.df <- read.csv("Data/small_mammals_aug2026.csv")
# records of small mammals spotted during surveys

snakes.master <- read.csv("Data/snakes_master_cleaned_aug2026.csv")
# all snake records

snakes.sur <- read.csv("Data/snake_surveys_cleaned_aug2026.csv")
# all the snake survey records, cleaned
# this version of snakes.sur has those two duplicates (SK04, 05) removed

```

# Prep snake data

```{r prep snake data}
snakes.sur$Distance_From_Trail_m <- as.numeric(snakes.sur$Distance_From_Trail_m)

# make one df of only cases where no snakes were found and keep relevant columns with it
surveys_without_snakes <- snakes.sur %>% filter(is.na(Snake_ID)) %>%
  select(Start_Date, Station, Segment, Seg_dist_m, Distance_From_Trail_m)

# tally up mammal eaters
n_mamm_eaters <- snakes.sur %>%
  filter(Diet_Type == "consumes_mammals") %>%
  group_by(Start_Date, Station, Segment, Seg_dist_m, Distance_From_Trail_m) %>%
  reframe(n_snakes = n()) 

# tally up non mammal eaters
n_non_mamm_eaters <- snakes.sur %>%
  filter(Diet_Type == "no_mammals") %>%
  group_by(Start_Date, Station, Segment, Seg_dist_m, Distance_From_Trail_m) %>%
  reframe(n_snakes = n()) 

# tally up Boidae
n_boids <- snakes.sur %>%
  filter(Family == "Boidae") %>%
  group_by(Start_Date, Station, Segment, Seg_dist_m, Distance_From_Trail_m) %>%
  reframe(n_snakes = n()) 

# tally up Colubridae
n_colubrids <- snakes.sur %>%
  filter(Family == "Colubridae") %>%
  group_by(Start_Date, Station, Segment, Seg_dist_m, Distance_From_Trail_m) %>%
  reframe(n_snakes = n()) 

surveys_without_snakes$n_snakes <- 0

# add zeros
n_mamm_eaters <- rbind(surveys_without_snakes, n_mamm_eaters)

n_non_mamm_eaters <- rbind(surveys_without_snakes, n_non_mamm_eaters)

n_boids <- rbind(surveys_without_snakes, n_boids)
n_colubrids <- rbind(surveys_without_snakes, n_colubrids)

# detection matrices with bins
mamm_eaters_DistDat <- formatDistData(n_mamm_eaters, distCol="Distance_From_Trail_m", transectNameCol="Segment", dist.breaks=c(0,1,2,4,6,12))

# repeat for non mamm eaters
non_mamm_eaters_DistDat <- formatDistData(n_non_mamm_eaters, distCol="Distance_From_Trail_m", transectNameCol="Segment", dist.breaks=c(0,1.5,2.5,4,6))

# boids
boids_DistDat <- formatDistData(n_boids, distCol="Distance_From_Trail_m", transectNameCol="Segment", dist.breaks=c(0,1,2,4,6,12))

# colubrids
colubrids_DistDat <- formatDistData(n_colubrids, distCol="Distance_From_Trail_m", transectNameCol="Segment", dist.breaks=c(0,1.5,2.5,4,6))

covs.mamm.eaters <- n_mamm_eaters %>%
  select(Station, Segment, Seg_dist_m) %>%
  distinct()

covs.non.mamm.eaters <- n_non_mamm_eaters %>%
  select(Station, Segment, Seg_dist_m) %>%
  distinct()

covs.boids <- n_boids %>%
  select(Station, Segment, Seg_dist_m) %>%
  distinct()

covs.colubrids <- n_colubrids %>%
  select(Station, Segment, Seg_dist_m) %>%
  distinct()
```

```{r make mamm eater umf}

mammal.eaters.umf <- unmarkedFrameDS(y=as.matrix(mamm_eaters_DistDat), siteCovs=covs.mamm.eaters, dist.breaks=c(0,1,2,4,6,12), unitsIn="m", survey="line", tlength = covs.mamm.eaters$Seg_dist_m)

hist(mammal.eaters.umf, xlab="distance (m)", main="", cex.lab=0.8, cex.axis=0.8)
```

```{r make non mamm eater umf}

non.mammal.eaters.umf <- unmarkedFrameDS(y=as.matrix(non_mamm_eaters_DistDat), siteCovs=covs.non.mamm.eaters, dist.breaks=c(0,1.5,2.5,4,6), unitsIn="m", survey="line", tlength = covs.non.mamm.eaters$Seg_dist_m)

hist(non.mammal.eaters.umf, xlab="distance (m)", main="", cex.lab=0.8, cex.axis=0.8)

```

```{r boidae umf}
hist(boid.umf, xlab="distance (m)", main="", cex.lab=0.8, cex.axis=0.8)
```

# Guild Density Estimates

## Models

```{r mammal eaters}

# first term is p, detection probability
# second term is density, N

null.mamm.eaters <- distsamp(~1 ~ 1, mammal.eaters.umf, unitsOut = "kmsq", keyfun = "uniform")

Station.mamm.eaters <- distsamp(~ 1 ~ Station, mammal.eaters.umf, unitsOut = "kmsq", keyfun = "uniform")

# Make a table to compare models

# put mods in a list
mod.set<- list(null.mamm.eaters = null.mamm.eaters, Station.mamm.eaters = Station.mamm.eaters)

# make table
aic_table <- aictab(cand.set = mod.set, sort = TRUE)

aic_table
```

```{r non mammal eaters}

# first term is p, detection probability
# second term is density, N

null.non.mamm.eaters <- distsamp(~1 ~ 1, non.mammal.eaters.umf, unitsOut = "kmsq", keyfun = "halfnorm")

Station.non.mamm.eaters <- distsamp(~ 1 ~ Station, non.mammal.eaters.umf, unitsOut = "kmsq", keyfun = "halfnorm")

# Make a table to compare models

# put mods in a list
mod.set<- list(null.non.mamm.eaters = null.non.mamm.eaters, Station.non.mamm.eaters = Station.non.mamm.eaters)

# make table
aic_table <- aictab(cand.set = mod.set, sort = TRUE)

aic_table
```

## GOF

```{r goodness of fit mamm eater mod}
pb_station_mammal_eaters <- parboot(Station.mamm.eaters, fitstats, nsim=200)
pb_station_mammal_eaters
# fine
```

```{r goodness of fit non mamm eater mod}
pb_null_non_mammal_eaters <- parboot(null.non.mamm.eaters, fitstats, nsim=100)
pb_null_non_mammal_eaters
# fine
```

## Guild density predictions

### Mammal eaters

```{r mamm eater predicted values}

new.data <- covs.mamm.eaters %>%
  dplyr::select(Station) %>%
  distinct()

#Predict
predictions_mamm_eaters <- predict(Station.mamm.eaters, type="state", newdata=new.data, appendData=TRUE)

```

```{r plot mamm eaters, message=FALSE, warning=FALSE}

p_mammal_eaters<-ggplot(predictions_mamm_eaters, aes(x=Station, y=Predicted)) +
  geom_errorbar(aes(ymin = Predicted - SE, ymax = Predicted + SE), width = .2) + geom_point(size = 2) + theme_pubclean() + xlab("") + scale_color_discrete(labels = "") +  scale_y_continuous(name = expression(bold(paste("Snakes /  ", km^bold("2"))))) + ggtitle("Density estimates of mammal-eating snakes") + theme(axis.text = element_text(color = "black"))+
  scale_x_discrete(labels = c("Unhunted", "Hunted"))

p_mammal_eaters

```

More mammal eating snakes predicted in hunted area.

